entity.description: Grouping of executable rules for reconciliation checks.

field.name: isActive
field.description:
DAR-BE-060. Y or N (absent reads as Y, so every run that predates this field stays enabled). A disabled run is retired, not removed: its results, diff documents and automation executions are the record of what was reconciled and when, and deleting the run to tidy a list would delete that evidence.
DISABLED MEANS IT DOES NOT RUN, on BOTH paths. A manual execution and a scheduled automation reach the pipeline separately, so the gate is applied at each — a flag that only hides a run from a list while it keeps firing nightly is worse than no flag, because the operator believes it is off.

field.name: isArchived
field.description:
DAR-BE-061. The trash. Y or N (absent reads as N, so nothing that predates this field arrives already binned).
DISTINCT FROM isActive, deliberately. isActive answers "does this run"; isArchived answers "is this still on the shelf". A disabled run stays listed — it is a run you have stopped for now. An archived one disappears from Home and the runs list, because the operator pressed a trash can and should feel that it went away.
Nothing is deleted. A run owns its results, its diff documents and its automation executions — the record of what was reconciled and when — so the bin is a flag, and Show archived brings it back intact.

entity.description: Single executable rule within a RuleSet.

field.name: companyUserGroupId

entity.description: RuleSet-owned compare object definition for reconciliation, such as Product, Order, OrderLine, or InventoryItem.

field.name: scopeMode
field.description:
COMPARE (default) diffs two sources; EVALUATE takes ONE source whose emitted rows ARE its findings, for exception checks like "which orders never shipped" where the predicate belongs to the extractor rather than to a cross-side diff (DAR-BE-049).
DELIBERATELY NULLABLE WITH NO DEFAULT ATTRIBUTE. Every scope configured before this field existed stores nothing, and resolveActiveSides reads a null as COMPARE, so adding the column needs NO upgrade data and cannot reclassify a live reconciliation. A stored value that is neither mode throws rather than falling back.

field.name: companyUserGroupId

entity.description: One file-side source definition for a RuleSet compare scope, including file-upload or API source metadata.

field.name: fileSide
field.description: Logical file side for the compare scope: FILE_1 or FILE_2.

field.name: sourceTypeEnumId
field.description: Optional source type for non-upload sources, such as AUT_SRC_API.

field.name: fileTypeEnumId
field.description: Optional file type override, such as DftCsv or DftJson.

field.name: schemaFileName
field.description: Optional schema filename used for validation or schema-guided extraction.

field.name: recordRootExpression
field.description: Optional root/explosion expression used to locate the repeated object records before ID extraction.

field.name: primaryIdExpression
field.description: Expression used to extract the primary compare ID from each uploaded object for this file side.

field.name: idValueNormalizer
field.description: Optional ID value normalizer (for example SHOPIFY_GID_TAIL) applied before compare.

field.name: systemMessageRemoteId
field.description: Optional SystemMessageRemote endpoint used when the source is API-backed.

field.name: nsRestletConfigId
field.description: Optional NetSuite RESTlet endpoint used when the source is API-backed.

field.name: sourceConfigId
field.description: System-specific API source configuration selected before the endpoint, such as Shopify auth, HotWax OMS REST source, or NetSuite auth.

field.name: sourceConfigType
field.description: Type discriminator for sourceConfigId, such as SHOPIFY_AUTH, HOTWAX_OMS_REST, or NETSUITE_AUTH.

field.name: companyUserGroupId

entity.description: One ordered field of a composite (multi-field) primary/compare key for a RuleSet compare source. When one or more rows exist for a (compareScopeId, fileSide), they replace that source's single primaryIdExpression: fields are evaluated in sequenceNum order and composed into one compare_id. When no rows exist, the source's primaryIdExpression is used unchanged (backward compatible).

field.name: fileSide
field.description: Logical file side for the compare scope: FILE_1 or FILE_2.

field.name: sequenceNum
field.description: Composition order: fields are concatenated in ascending sequenceNum order.

field.name: fieldExpression
field.description: Expression identifying one field of the composite key, using the same JSONPath/CSV-column syntax as primaryIdExpression, optionally suffixed with |NORMALIZER (for example SHOPIFY_GID_TAIL).

field.name: companyUserGroupId
field.description: Denormalized owning-tenant stamp copied from the parent RuleSet (defense-in-depth; the parent RuleSet stays the authoritative tenant boundary).

entity.description: One record-exclusion rule for a RuleSet compare source. Records whose fieldExpression value matches any of filterValues are dropped by the source getter at extraction time, before the records reach the extract file. When no rows exist for a (compareScopeId, fileSide) the source extracts exactly as it did before this feature (backward compatible).

field.name: fileSide
field.description: Logical file side for the compare scope: FILE_1 or FILE_2.

field.name: sequenceNum
field.description: Rule evaluation and display order. The first matching rule owns the excluded count.

field.name: fieldExpression
field.description: Top-level record field tested by this rule, for example salesChannelEnumId. Matched trimmed and case-sensitively, the same way the built-in orderTypeId filter matches.

field.name: operator
field.description: EXCLUDE_IN drops records whose fieldExpression value is listed in filterValues. INCLUDE_IN keeps only records whose value is listed, and drops records carrying no usable value for the field at all. Several rules may share a field, but they must agree on direction; mixing operators on one field is rejected at save.

field.name: filterValues
field.description: Comma-separated exact values this rule tests, matched trimmed and case-insensitively. The operator decides whether they are excluded or are the only ones kept. Values containing commas are unsupported; enum ids never contain one.

field.name: companyUserGroupId
field.description: Denormalized owning-tenant stamp copied from the parent RuleSet (defense-in-depth; the parent RuleSet stays the authoritative tenant boundary).

entity.description: DAR-UI-044. One named conclusion a compare scope can reach about a finding. Rules are evaluated in sequenceNum order and the FIRST whose conditions all hold wins; no match is UNEXPLAINED. The page renders "How Darpan concluded" from the winning rule's conditions, so an explanation can never claim what the rule did not test.

field.name: conclusionEnumId
field.description: Enumeration of type DarpanConclusion; its description is the label.

field.name: appliesToBucket
field.description: MISSING_FROM_FILE_1, MISSING_FROM_FILE_2 or FINDING (single-sided). Blank = any.

field.name: questionText
field.description: Optional open question shown under "Needs a decision". Terse page copy.

field.name: suggestedFilterJson
field.description: With questionText: {fileSide, fieldExpression, operator, values} the rules board opens pre-filled.

entity.description: DAR-UI-044. One condition of a conclusion rule; all of a rule's conditions must hold.

field.name: subject
field.description: FILE_1 or FILE_2: which side's record the condition reads.

field.name: presence
field.description: KEPT (in the extract), EXCLUDED (screened out by a source filter, read from the sidecar), ABSENT (neither), or ANY.

field.name: keyScope
field.description: FULL matches the whole composite key; FIRST_FIELD matches the first key field only (e.g. the order, when the key is order + NetSuite id).

field.name: operator
field.description: IN, NOT_IN, GT_ZERO, BLANK, NOT_BLANK. Blank with a blank fieldExpression = presence only.
